name: OS Client Certs -- cert9.db cleanup
description: EXPERIMENT BUILD, not for production: single-shot cleanup 10 seconds after startup (no periodic timer), still reloading the osclientcerts PKCS#11 module after deleting. Minimal test to confirm/deny whether a single mid-session delete blocks reading encrypted mail on this build. See tools/thunderbird-cert-cleanup/README.md and the experiment/cert-cleanup-mid-session branch.
